lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: You have called us out of darkest night into your glorious light
That we may shake the wonders of the risen Christ
May our every breath retell the grace
That broke into our strife
With boundless love and deepest joy
With endless life
May the peoples praise you let the nations be glad

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: All your blessing comes that we may praise
May praise the name of Jesus

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: All the earth is yours and all within
Each harvest is your own

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: And from your hand we give to you to make Christ known
May the seeds of mercy grow in us for those who have not heard

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: May songs of praise build lives of grace to spread your word
May the peoples praise you
Let the nations be glad
